governing_prompt.clean_specification_rule: Agent A records observed product behaviour; Agent B rewrites only the blind behaviour payload as neutral user needs, states, and acceptance criteria; Agent C compares that neutral specification with current-product evidence.

lineage_correction.reason: A prior neutral packet did not consume the sanitized observed behaviour and is not an input to this blind handoff.
lineage_correction.semantic_correction: All observed couplings and object boundaries are preserved for fresh neutralization; contextual improvements are excluded.

blind_payload_contract.packet_identity: Opaque packet IDs only; feature IDs, facet keys, benchmark project identities, and source identities are withheld from Agent B.
blind_payload_contract.stable_atom_id_rule: Within each packet, field name plus one-based list position is the stable blind atom identity.
preserved: whether the observed slice is exact, partial, or adjacent only
removed: URLs, revisions, licences, and edition identities
source paths, classes, methods, fields, schemas, and framework names
feature IDs, facet keys, and formal selection outcomes
blind_payload_contract.canonical_hash_rule: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON for packets only, sorted keys, compact separators, and non-ASCII characters preserved
